items.quote: After completing my graduation, I was honestly very confused about whether MBA was the right choice for me. There were so many specializations and colleges, and I did not want to make the wrong decision. That’s when I reached out for counseling. They didn’t just suggest ‘do an MBA’—they actually helped me understand which specialization suits my strengths and long-term goals. The way they explained everything—colleges, placements, future scope—made things much clearer. With their guidance, I chose the right college and specialization. Looking back, taking guidance at the right time made all the difference.
items.name: Shruti Kumari
